The '''Mk 2e/W medium blaster cannon''' was a type of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]].<ref name="MBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref> Some [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] were armed with two of these weapons.<ref name="SPB">{{JournalCite|9|Stand at Bhir'khi Pass (article)}}</ref>
